objectClass.notes: A complete phone-scale Three.js world reconstructed from one high front-three-quarter concept. Baked UI and illustrative route geometry are excluded.

reasoning: The visible scene contains a terrain shell, railway, articulated locomotive, five distinct architectural landmarks, repeated geological/background systems and sparse botanical dressing.
Fidelity depends on nested component relationships, material separation, repeated modules, multiple animation pivots and phone/orbit review.
The single view creates high occlusion risk for rear facades, underside, tunnel and landmark construction states.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Choose simple/moderate/complex/ultra-complex from observed structure, not from a hardcoded domain.

details.description: Peach-gold sky transitions into lower-value lavender haze behind the far buttes; soft cloud bands remain atmospheric rather than solid scenery.
Distant vertical buttes use stacked horizontal strata shelves and softened eroded corners with decreasing contrast through depth.
details.affects: far canyon silhouette and atmospheric depth

details.description: The central station stacks a broad gabled base, narrower upper rooms and a steep bell-tower roof into one dominant stepped silhouette.
Repeated narrow arched windows emit restrained amber light from recessed dark openings across the station tiers.
details.affects: inhabited station read and warm/cool separation

details.description: Dark timber posts, cross braces, plank seams and lighter worn edges articulate each gabled volume.
A small star flag, pole finial and visible bell/cupola hardware terminate the station tower.
A dense radial set of tapered metal blades attaches to one hub above the timber trestle and ranch roof.
The cylindrical tank sits on four tall timber legs with cross-braced bays, a conical metal roof and projecting pipework.
Two continuous steel rails form a dark elliptical band with a narrow bright upper highlight and rusty side response.
Closely spaced timber sleepers and small spikes repeat beneath the rails with even path spacing and slight value variation.
Multiple dark wheels with brass rims are linked by a horizontal connecting rod below the blue-black boiler and cab.
White steam exits the chimney while soot-darkening concentrates around the upper stack and boiler seams.
A deep black rail opening cuts through an orange rock mound with a blocky weathered arch and small sign plate above.
details.affects: rail continuity and right-side negative space

details.description: The compact two-storey sheriff office uses a deep porch, square roof lantern, projecting sign silhouette and side fence.
The floating cliff face is broken into vertical fins by deep dark grooves, with horizontal shelf bands and irregular chipped rim blocks.
details.affects: floating mesa depth and geological read

details.description: Broken sandstone edges are brighter ochre while recessed cracks and undersides shift to dark terracotta/brown.
Saguaro cacti vary in height, arm count and sage/olive value; longitudinal ribs catch thin highlights.
Short timber fences, crates, barrels, sheds and posts create irregular clusters between buildings and cliff edges without filling every gap.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: At the approved 390×844 overview the world immediately reads as the supplied Cactus Canyon: fractured floating red-rock mesa, double railway, central frontier tower, four distinct satellites, locomotive, cacti and layered sunset buttes.
The real 36-tile route remains complete and readable; railway, buildings, cacti and effects never replace or obscure gameplay geometry.
Left and right orbit views prove non-planar terrain, attached structures, continuous rails and coherent inferred rear construction.
All repeated systems are instanced or merged where practical, High remains within approximately 175 draw calls and 180k triangles, and reduced motion freezes decoration safely.

featureGroups.name: Floating mesa and concentric railway silhouette
qualityCriteria: The mesa has a broad asymmetric shelf and fractured vertical underside rather than a smooth round sand disc.
Two continuous dark railway bands encircle the town and remain visually separate from the live tile route.
failureModes: terrain reads as a generic sandy island
railway is missing, discontinuous or confused with playable tiles

featureGroups.name: Five distinct frontier landmark identities
qualityCriteria: Union Station is dominant; windmill, water tower, signal yard and sheriff archive have unmistakably different silhouettes.
Every building uses frontier gables, timber framing, porches and warm windows without becoming five repeated houses.
failureModes: central station reads as a generic pavilion or dome
windmill or water tower is absent

featureGroups.name: Locomotive, windmill and mechanical life
qualityCriteria: The locomotive has a readable boiler, cab, tender, wheels, rods and chimney socketed into one articulated hierarchy.
Train motion follows the rail path with elapsed time; windmill rotor pivots locally and steam originates at the chimney.
failureModes: locomotive is missing or reads as a static rectangular prop
wheels, rods, rotor or steam float away from their parents

featureGroups.name: Layered canyon depth and sparse vegetation
qualityCriteria: Near, mid and far buttes diminish in scale, saturation and contrast through peach haze.
Sparse varied saguaro/barrel cacti, fence lines and frontier props populate ground without entering the protected route corridor.
failureModes: background is a single flat mountain ring
canyon depth rotates with the camera as near scenery
vegetation becomes lush/tropical or obstructs tiles

featureGroups.name: Warm canyon material and late-day lighting response
qualityCriteria: Sandstone, pale ground, dark timber, steel, brass, amber windows and cactus greens retain distinct albedo/roughness/metalness response.
Upper-left warm key light and peach environment depth preserve the source value range without baked illumination in albedo.
Strata, timber grain, rail highlights and cavity dirt remain readable under reference-matched and orbit lighting.
failureModes: all surfaces collapse to flat orange plastic
timber, rail steel and sandstone share one response
lighting loses the warm late-day canyon depth

visualDeltaChecks: fractured mesa and railway silhouette delta
locomotive presence, articulation and rail-path delta
near/mid/far canyon depth and warm haze delta
phone route readability and landmark prominence delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).

authoringInstruction: Fill observed object class, complexity reasoning, featureGroups, visualDeltaChecks, and unknowns before generating or implementing ObjectSculptSpec.
